import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from kt import *

FAIL = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAIL.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got ", json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True))
        print("  want", json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True))
    else:
        print("ok  ", name)

types = [{"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 32},
         {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"},
         {"name": "Pt", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["x", "N"], ["y", "N"]]},
         {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "Pt", "size": 2},
         {"name": "Inner", "kind": "array", "element": "N", "size": 2},
         {"name": "Outer", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["items", "Inner"], ["more", "Inner"]]},
         {"name": "S", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 5}]

def build(requires, params=None, result=None):
    if params is None:
        params = [["a", "Arr"], ["s", "S"], ["n", "N"], ["o", "Outer"]]
    if result is None:
        result = ["r", "Flag"]
    return [{"name": "main", "params": params, "result": result, "requires": requires}]

def objects(a=((1, 2), (3, 4)), s="abc", n=0, items=(1, 1), more=(2, 2), result=0):
    out = [("x2", u(a[0][0], 4)), ("x3", u(a[0][1], 4)),
           ("x5", u(a[1][0], 4)), ("x6", u(a[1][1], 4))]
    text = (s + "\x00" * 5).encode('latin-1')[:5]
    for i in range(5):
        out.append(("x%d" % (8 + i), text[i:i+1]))
    out.append(("x13", u(n, 4)))
    # outer struct: id 14 -> items id 15 (elements 16,17) more id 18 (elements 19,20)
    out.append(("x16", u(items[0], 4)))
    out.append(("x17", u(items[1], 4)))
    out.append(("x19", u(more[0], 4)))
    out.append(("x20", u(more[1], 4)))
    out.append(("x21", bytes([result])))
    return out

def one(requires, **kwargs):
    camp = {"types": types, "modules": build(requires), "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["main"], "machine": None,
            "runs": [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest(objects(**kwargs))}]}
    out = run(camp)
    return out['records'][0]['status']

# all with a struct field
check("all true", one(["all", "p", ["var", "a"], ["gt", ["field", ["var", "p"], "x"], ["const", "N", 0]]]), "READY")
check("all false", one(["all", "p", ["var", "a"], ["gt", ["field", ["var", "p"], "x"], ["const", "N", 2]]]), "FILTERED")
# all over an empty array is true
check("all empty", one(["all", "p", ["var", "a"], ["eq", ["var", "p"], ["const", "Pt", {"x": 0, "y": 0}]]],
                       a=((0, 0), (0, 0))), "FILTERED")
# match
check("match true", one(["match", ["var", "s"], "abc"]), "READY")
check("match false", one(["match", ["var", "s"], "abd"]), "FILTERED")
check("match literal dot", one(["match", ["var", "s"], "a.c"]), "FILTERED")
check("match class", one(["match", ["var", "s"], "[a-c]+"]), "READY")
check("match star", one(["match", ["var", "s"], "a*"]), "READY")
check("match union", one(["match", ["var", "s"], "ab|xy"]), "READY")
check("match full", one(["match", ["var", "s"], "a"]), "FILTERED")
# field and index
check("field", one(["eq", ["field", ["var", "a"], "0"], ["const", "N", 0]], a=((0, 0), (0, 0))), "FILTERED")
check("index", one(["eq", ["index", ["var", "a"], 1], ["const", "N", 0]], a=((0, 0), (0, 0))), "FILTERED")
check("index of const", one(["eq", ["index", ["const", "Arr", [{"x": 5, "y": 6}, {"x": 7, "y": 8}]], 0], ["const", "N", 5]]), "READY")
# arithmetic modulo
check("add modulo", one(["eq", ["add", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 4294967295]], ["const", "N", 0]], n=1), "READY")
check("sub modulo", one(["eq", ["sub", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 1]], ["const", "N", 4294967295]], n=0), "READY")
# logical
check("and", one(["and", ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 0]], ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 1]]]), "FILTERED")
check("or", one(["or", ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 0]], ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 1]]]), "READY")
check("implies", one(["implies", ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 5]], ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 1]]]), "READY")
check("not", one(["not", ["eq", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 5]]]), "READY")
check("ne", one(["ne", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 5]]), "READY")
check("le", one(["le", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 0]]), "READY")
check("gt", one(["gt", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", 0]]), "FILTERED")
# sibling bindings do not interfere
check("sibling bindings",
      one(["and",
           ["all", "e", ["field", ["var", "o"], "items"], ["eq", ["var", "e"], ["const", "N", 1]]],
           ["all", "e", ["field", ["var", "o"], "more"], ["eq", ["var", "e"], ["const", "N", 2]]]]),
      "READY")
check("sibling bindings 2",
      one(["and",
           ["all", "e", ["field", ["var", "o"], "items"], ["eq", ["var", "e"], ["const", "N", 1]]],
           ["all", "e", ["field", ["var", "o"], "more"], ["eq", ["var", "e"], ["const", "N", 3]]]]),
      "FILTERED")
# string constant with an embedded NUL is distinct from the truncated value
types2 = [{"name": "S", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 3}, {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}]
mods2 = [{"name": "main", "params": [["s", "S"]], "result": ["r", "Flag"],
          "requires": ["eq", ["var", "s"], ["const", "S", "a\x00b"]]}]
camp = {"types": types2, "modules": mods2, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["main"],
        "machine": None,
        "runs": [{"entry": "main", "ktest": ktest([("x1", b"a"), ("x2", b"\x00"), ("x3", b"b"),
                                                  ("x4", b"\x00"), ("x5", b"\x00"), ("x6", b"\x00")])}]}
out = run(camp)
check("nul constant distinct", out['records'][0]['status'], "FILTERED")
check("nul constant corpus", out['corpus'][0]['inputs'], {"s": "a"})

print()
print("FAILURES:", FAIL if FAIL else "none")
PYEOF
